{"metadata":{"description":"Novel writer plugin for DeepSeek Harness.","id":"gh:1408716998","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"whalesong-studio","slug":"xuhao1/whalesong-studio","topics":["ai-agents","deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh-plugin","fiction","novel-writing"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Novel writer plugin for DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English · 简体中文 · Tutorial · Everything it does · Website"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# Whalesong Studio"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Write a long novel with a crew of AI agents — a plugin for DeepSeek Harness.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**Whalesong Studio** (鲸歌工坊) is for writing long fiction with AI. You talk to a showrunner; behind it"},{"id":"p5s2","text":", a small crew writes, keeps track of the story, reviews, draws and gives it a voice. Hundreds of th"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ousands of words in, your characters are still themselves and the story still adds up. When the book"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" is done, you can publish it as an illustrated website in one click."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It isn't a role-play front end or a "generate a chapter" button: you make the calls, and each model "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"does the part it is good at."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"*Lewis Carroll's* Alice's Adventures in Wonderland *imported into the Studio, open beside a conversa"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"tion with the showrunner. Every picture in these screenshots was drawn in the Studio.*"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**See what it makes:** two classics published with Whalesong Studio — read *Alice's Adventures in Wo"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"nderland* or *Dream of the Red Chamber* (红楼梦, in Chinese) online. The first chapters can be listened"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" to as well — the first three of *Alice*, the first ten of 红楼梦 — voiced by the Studio. Once inside, "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"click **People** and **World** at the top: every character has a page of their own, the main ones wi"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"th portraits, and the places can be walked into one inside another."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> **New here?** The tutorial walks you through it with screenshots, from installing to your first il"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"e tutorial walks you through it with screenshots, from installing to your first illustrated chapter."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## A crew, not a single model"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Models that plan well and use tools well rarely write beautiful prose, and the best prose writers ra"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"rely manage a big project well. So Whalesong Studio doesn't ask one model to do everything:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Role | What it does |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| **Showrunner** (总编) | The one you talk to, on any model you like. Works out what you want, plans w"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"hat comes next, hands out the work and reports back. It never writes the story itself. |
| **Writer*"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"* (写手) | Writes the prose, on a model you choose. Before every chapter it is handed everything that "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"chapter needs: the setting, where each character stands, what came before, the open threads, the out"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"line and the style. |
| **Continuity** (场记) | Remembers. After every chapter it notes what happened "},{"id":"p13s6","text":"and how everyone has changed. It also reviews like an editor — and when it says something contradict"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"s an earlier chapter, it shows you the passage. |
| **Planner** (策划) | Has the ideas. Works out what"},{"id":"p13s8","text":" could happen next, fleshes out the characters and the world, tries "what if…" turns of the story, a"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"nd can look things up on the web. |
| **Director** (导演) | Sound and pictures. Adapts chapters into a"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"udio drama and storyboards, and plays everyone else when you step into a scene as one of the charact"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"ers. |
| **Post-production** (后期) | Edits voices, sound and pictures into a video, checks the result"},{"id":"p13s12","text":" itself, and hands it over only when it passes. |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The four crew members are real agents running on DeepSeek Harness's own agent loop, and every job th"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ey do leaves a full record in your conversation: what they looked up, what they handed in, what it c"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ost. Prefer buttons to chat? Everything can be done from the Studio's own screens, too."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Hundreds of thousands of words in, nothing is forgotten"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"After every chapter the Studio notes what happened, where each character stands and which threads mo"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ved. When the next chapter is written, the writer gets a summary of everything before plus the last "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"few chapters in full — the whole book, while it's short enough — along with any earlier passages tha"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"t matter. A style profile keeps the voice steady. Ask for what comes next, a fix to a paragraph, a r"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ewrite of a chapter or one change carried through the whole book: every change is shown to you first"},{"id":"p17s6","text":", side by side, and the previous version is always kept."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Every character gets a page, every place can be explored"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Each character has a card — personality, relationships, what they go through in the book, how they l"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ook and sound — and every later picture and spoken line follows it. Places nest inside one another: "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"Wonderland holds the hall of doors, the wood, the garden and the March Hare's house. Beside the text"},{"id":"p19s4","text":", **People** shows each character's page with a large portrait, and **World** opens any place to sho"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"w its picture, what it contains and who lives there."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| *People — who they are, how they look, what they go through* | *World — what is in a place, and wh"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"they are, how they look, what they go through* | *World — what is in a place, and who lives there* |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Read it, hear it, watch it"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"A reader with careful typography and the book's own pictures in the text; one switch turns it into a"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"n audiobook, with every character keeping one voice through the whole book. Pictures stay consistent"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" too: each character first gets a design sheet — front, side and back — and every later picture is d"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"rawn to match. Go further with an **audio drama**, a **motion comic** that plays along with the voic"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"es, a chapter cut into a **video**, or an **interlude** — play one of the characters in a scene whil"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"e the others answer you."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| *Read — and with one switch, listen* | *Gallery — one look per book; every picture remembers how i"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" with one switch, listen* | *Gallery — one look per book; every picture remembers how it was made* |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The pictures can come from any image model you like — GPT Image, Qwen-Image, FLUX, Seedream… or a mo"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"del running on your own computer."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Publish it as a work of digital art"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"When the book is ready, publish it as a website in one click: the text set for reading, a portrait a"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"nd a short biography for every character, and places your readers can step into. Nothing to install,"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" and it reads well on a phone. The two classics linked above were made exactly this way."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## What is sent where"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Text goes to the models you chose for the roles: a role that follows the conversation model or use"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"s a Harness model goes through the Harness LLM runtime (the same routes, credentials and retry polic"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"y as your conversations); a role with an endpoint of its own is called by the Studio directly.
- Ima"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ge prompts, the text of lines to be spoken and (if enabled) text chunks to be embedded go to the med"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"ia endpoints you configured. Nothing is sent to any endpoint you did not configure; there is no tele"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"metry.
- Keys stay in the Harness credential store on your machine and are only ever sent to the end"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"point host they were entered for.
- Books stay in your workspace. Settings live in `$DSH_HOME/novel-"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"t they were entered for.
- Books stay in your workspace. Settings live in `$DSH_HOME/novel-writer/`."}],"truncated":true}
